templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties evaluating or pursuing a business relationship.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the variable terms: purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, and signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, restrictions, payment, privacy and security, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early partner access to a pre-release product in exchange for feedback, covering product access, feedback rights, confidentiality, and term.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms defining target uptime, target response times for support, service credits, and remedies for a cloud service provider.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented data processing terms covering processor and subprocessor relationships, data subject rights, international transfers, security, and breach notification.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for licensing on-premise or installable software, covering license grant, restrictions, payment, support, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships covering each party's cooperation obligations, trademark licensing, fees, confidentiality, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term trial agreement allowing a prospective customer to evaluate a product during a pilot period before committing to a longer-term contract.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate terms governing how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI), including breach reporting.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement for AI features, covering use of AI services, ownership of inputs and outputs, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
